_what: Plumbing fixtures onto the fixtures the architectural plans draw (fixturefit.rs). Sizes are the outline as drawn in plan, inches: part = [short side min, short side max, long side min, long side max].
_basis: A plumbing plan tags a fixture with a balloon set beside it, clear of the fixture's own linework: the architectural plan the plumbing plan is drawn over places the fixture. Sizes are the common catalog and drafting sizes of each fixture as drawn in plan.
_reach_ft: How far from its tag a fixture may be drawn. A tag balloon sits a balloon or two off its fixture, out of its linework, often across a tub or a door swing from it.
_join_in: Outlines this close are one fixture's pieces (a water closet's tank drawn against its bowl).
_outline_gap_in: An outline left open by this much or less is still the fixture's outline (a basin's line broken at its faucet).
_largest_in: Nothing larger is one fixture's outline (a room, a wall run).
_drain_in: A drain or faucet hole drawn in a basin: a small round mark this wide (a circle, or a short closed line, often a square turned on its corner). Anything larger inside a basin-sized outline (a cooktop's burners) makes it no basin.
_counter_in: A counter a basin is drawn in: the smallest outline round it with its short side (its depth) in this range.

drawn.what: its bowl, no tank drawn as an outline

families._drawn: An elongated or round bowl (14-15 in wide, 16-22 in deep) with its tank (about 20 in by 8-10 in) against it; where the tank isn't drawn as an outline, the curved bowl alone (a weaker likeness, taken only when no bowl and tank is near).
A bathtub: 30-36 in by 60 in (54-72 in); where only its basin is drawn, that inner line (about 26 by 55 in). The outer line wins where both are drawn.
A shower base or roll-in shower: 32-36 in square up to 36 by 60 in, a roll-in pan up to 60 by 72 in. Listed after the tub: a tub shower is its tub.
A basin (oval, round or rectangular, 13-22 in) in a vanity 18-22 in deep, or wall-hung with no counter (a weaker likeness); else the drain drawn in its vanity top.
A mop or service sink: a floor basin 24 in square up to 24 by 36 in, in no counter. Listed before the sink.

A sink basin (single bowl 13-25 in, double bowl up to 33-36 in) in its counter 24-25 in deep (a kitchen, bar or laundry counter): a rounded box of a basin's size in no counter is a seat or a stool, no sink.
